body.name: Saturated ordered response-superarchitecture list
body.construction: For each topological order on \(W\), form one saturated superarchitecture containing every forward directed slot and one formal independent source \(U_C\) for every nonempty \(C\subseteq W\).  Thus at most \(A_{\max}=N!\) labeled superarchitectures are generated.  A missing directed arrow is encoded by tables that are constant in that input.  An absent source is encoded by a simplex vertex, with one slot of mass one and the remaining slots of mass zero, and every incident table ignores that source; an all-zero mass vector is never used.  If a formally named \(U_C\) is active only on \(D\subsetneq C\), its realized child set is \(D\).  Before projection, discard empty realized child sets and merge formal sources with the same nonempty realized child set into one tuple source.  For each saturated order enumerate all dense deterministic tables, bounded by \(R_{\max}\), using at most \(K_{\max}=m+3\) slots per formal source, and retain the exact projected selected MAGs \(G\in\mathcal G(\mathcal P)\).
